instruction.name: AESKEYGENASSIST

para.string: Assist in expanding the AES cipher key, by computing steps towards generating a round key for encryption, using 128-bit data specified in the source operand and an 8-bit round constant specified as an immediate, store the result in the destination operand.
The destination operand is an XMM register. The source operand can be an XMM register or a 128-bit memory loca­tion.
128-bit Legacy SSE version: Bits (MAXVL-1:128) of the corresponding YMM destination register remain unchanged.
VEX.128 encoded version: Bits (MAXVL-1:128) of the destination YMM register are zeroed.
Note: In VEX-encoded versions, VEX.vvvv is reserved and must be 1111b, otherwise instructions will #UD.
